about: Qwen3.8-27B EXL3 3.0 bpw + DFlash2 speculative decoding (3.0 bpw draft) on TabbyAPI, with RDNA4 kernels and DeltaNet accepted-input replay for gfx1201; from parth-thakre/exl3-rdna4-recipe
setup: Not Docker; Linux on an RX 9070 / 9070 XT (gfx1201). setup/ builds a venv with PyTorch 2.13 (ROCm 7.2 wheels), clones upstream exllamav3 dev at 0662fac and applies patches/exllamav3-rdna4.patch (gfx12 WMMA multi-row GEMV, HIP graphs off as upstream now defaults on ROCm (96838c9 backported), GQA split-decode attention, Gated DeltaNet accepted-input replay, 16/32-row batched verify), installs upstream TabbyAPI at 2fd6cc7 unpatched, and requantizes the bf16 DFlash2 draft to 3.0 bpw (setup/requant_draft.sh, a few minutes on the GPU). Needs system ROCm 7.x plus a host gcc; tested on Fedora 44 with ROCm 7.1.1. Serves 128K context shared by up to 3 concurrent requests; vision encoder kept in system RAM. Peaks around 16.1 GiB of the card's 16.
